title: Processes: Crop growth: leaf, stem, root, storage organ
intro: The crop develops with the development stage (DS), leaf area index (LAI), height and rooting depth; dry matter and nitrogen are partitioned to leaf, stem, storage organ and root, under water and nitrogen stress; at harvest the storage organ leaves the field and the rest becomes residue.
